youtube.baslik: How can an ear that misses soft sounds hear loud ones? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The cochlear amplifier gives most gain to soft sounds and little to loud ones, compressing a wide range of levels. When outer hair cells are lost, this compression is lost too: soft sounds are missed, but loud sounds quickly reach normal loudness. This abnormal growth of loudness is called recruitment.
